name: Negapoji Fandisk ~Hitotsu Yane no Shita de~
original_name: ねがぽじファンディスク～ひとつ屋根の下で～
source:
Among other goodies there are three short stories:
● Scenario A: 「ひとつ屋根の下で」 Under one roof. 
● Scenario B: 「やり方を教えて」 Tell me how to do it.  
● Scenario C: Too late.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-january-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
